page_title: JUV 0-0 TOR | Juventus v Torino 08/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+4' Vasilije Adzic (Juventus) takes the corner.
90+2' Edon Zhegrova (Juventus) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
90+1' Edon Zhegrova (Juventus) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
88' Leonardo Colucci prepares a substitution. Ardian Ismajli is replaced by Adrien Tameze (Torino).
87' Duvan Zapata (Torino) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Luca Zufferli who sees an offensive foul.
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Manuel Locatelli trots off the pitch and is replaced by Vasilije Adzic (Juventus).
84' Kenan Yildiz will be replaced by Lois Openda (Juventus).
82' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Valentino Lazaro (Torino), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
79' Leonardo Colucci has decided to substitute Nikola Vlasic and he is replaced by Faustino Anjorin (Torino).
79' Here's the change. Giovanni Simeone leaves the pitch and Duvan Zapata (Torino) comes on as a substitute.
79' Che Adams (Torino) commits a rough challenge and Luca Zufferli blows his whistle for a foul.
77' Juventus have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
77' A nice individual effort by Jonathan David (Juventus) comes to nothing as his shot is blocked on the edge of the box by a defender.
75' The resulting set piece from Juventus is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
73' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the middle of the goal, but Alberto Paleari has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.

71' Kristjan Asllani (Torino) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and has an effort on goal. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies inches high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
70' Edon Zhegrova (Juventus) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
68' Edon Zhegrova (Juventus) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

68' What a save from Alberto Paleari! Weston McKennie (Juventus) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out. Juventus force a corner. They send men into the box.

67' Jonathan David (Juventus) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Alberto Paleari to get hold of the ball.
65' Edon Zhegrova (Juventus) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
64' Luciano Spalletti decides to make a substitution. Dusan Vlahovic will be replaced by Jonathan David (Juventus).
64' Here comes a substitution. Francisco Conceicao is given a rest as he is replaced by Edon Zhegrova (Juventus).
64' Kristjan Asllani (Torino) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Luca Zufferli had an easy-decision to make.
63' Torino can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
63' Che Adams (Torino) zig-zags his way into the box and drills a low shot towards the right post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a superb stop.
62' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Torino.
60' Michele Di Gregorio makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded by Giovanni Simeone (Torino) after a cross from the side.
54' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.

49' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
48' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Giovanni Simeone (Torino) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
47' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Leonardo Colucci gives a chance to Che Adams and Cyril Ngonge (Torino) is off.
46' Leonardo Colucci has made a change at the break. Kristjan Asllani has come on in place of Ivan Ilic (Torino).
46' Half-time substitution. Daniele Rugani (Juventus) will not participate anymore and Federico Gatti is coming on.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
45+1' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
45+1' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alberto Paleari intercepts the ball.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) is having a lively performance. He is causing problems and wanting the ball at every opportunity.
43' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.

41' Great solo effort from Francisco Conceicao (Juventus)! He beat a couple of players and shot from the edge of the box, but the effort slips just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
40' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) and Kenan Yildiz combine well with a quick one-two to trick their opponent.
39' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
38' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
36' Luca Zufferli blows his whistle after Khephren Thuram (Juventus) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
34' The Torino players are exchanging some short passes.
33' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) finds the space inside the box to meet a cross, but his effort from near the penalty spot towards the right post is saved by the goalkeeper.
31' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) dribbles into the box, but Michele Di Gregorio is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.

31' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) serves up a nice cross, but Alberto Paleari punches the ball away. Alberto Paleari makes a brilliant save! Khephren Thuram (Juventus) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper low into the middle of the goal.
30' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
27' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
26' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
25' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
23' Cyril Ngonge (Torino) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
21' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
20' Weston McKennie is not given a chance to finish after receiving a sweet pass by Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus). The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
17' Cyril Ngonge (Torino) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
16' 69:31 – the latest ball possession ratio. The current number of shots on target for both teams is 3:0.
14' Juventus take the free kick with a short pass.
14' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Luca Zufferli blows for a foul. Juventus will take a free kick near the side line.
13' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
12' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
10' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) dived to the ground without any contact with the opponent.

7' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) bursts into the box and pulls the trigger, but he can't beat the goalkeeper. He directed his daisy-cutter towards the left post, but one of the defenders reacted brilliantly to block it.
6' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
5' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee blows his whistle, Torino are awarded a corner kick.
5' Good clearance! Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) receives a brilliant short pass and finds himself in a good position inside the box, but he's robbed of the ball by one of the defending players.
5' Juventus hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
4' The ball is cleared after Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
2' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

1' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Juventus will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Torino will kick-off.
Luca Zufferli was nominated as the referee for this game.
